Field Manual 02: give people a reason to come back.

Communities grow around rituals. A weekly event gives people a reason to return:

1. Pick one night and keep it.
2. Make joining easy: no sign-up.
3. Show up yourself, every week.
4. Post a reminder the day of.

It's how Black Point runs its weekends.
